## Software

The main outcome is `spicefault.testdesign`, a module that generates, from a netlist, the self-test plan that reaches a coverage target at minimum hardware cost, its diagnostic coverage with a confidence interval and an export to the FMEDA. Each release will be deposited with a DOI so that the papers cite the exact code they use.

::: {.draft}
First public release planned for the close of WP1.
:::
